note: The main banks were taken as Bulgaria's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): UniCredit Bulbank, DSK Bank and UBB. DSK Bank: its tariff for individuals (in force from 1 September 2026), whose bank cards section links each card's own sheet, the sheet for its Visa credit cards with revolving credit (the card the April 2026 tariff called Visa Galaxy, now the 'Credit card'), and its credit card page, read 2026-10-30. The card costs 25 euros a year for the main card; the fee isn't charged where the card makes 24 transactions in its first year, or under some of the bank's plans, conditions the game doesn't check, so it is charged in full. It bears 18.90% a year, the page's standard loan interest rate, with up to 45 days without interest. A withdrawal at DSK's own ATMs costs 2.10 euros plus 3% (3.60 plus 3% at others, not written), and an unpaid minimum 8 euros, written as the late fee. The Platinum credit card is issued only under the bank's Premium and Private Banking plans from 1 July 2026, and the DSK-Wizz Air card only to specific client segments, so neither is written. The page doesn't state the minimum's share. UniCredit Bulbank's card pages answered with a captcha, UBB's refused the request (403) and Postbank's answered with a Cloudflare check, so none is written. Fibank (First Investment Bank), one of Bulgaria's large banks, was added in wave 4 as the second bank (UniCredit Bulbank, UBB and Postbank having answered with bot checks or refusals in wave 3): its Mastercard and Visa credit card pages, read 2026-10-30. The Mastercard Standard, Gold, Platinum and Platinum First Lady and the Visa Classic, Gold and Platinum have no yearly fee in the first year, then 23.01, 51.13 and 127.82 euros a year (Standard/Classic, Gold, Platinum), none 'with active use', a condition not defined on the page and not checked, so the fee is charged from the second year; each bears 17.90% a year on payments and 18.90% on cash withdrawals (written as the cash rate), with up to 45 days' grace. The pages give no cash fee, currency fee, minimum or default charge (the tariff they link wasn't read).
